implementation.description: Experimental rule-based environmental risk assessment using observed rainfall and weather forecast inputs.

prediction_target.name: environmental_flood_risk_score
prediction_target.interpretation: Experimental environmental risk score from 0 to 100. It is not a calibrated probability of flooding or a validated flood forecast.

observations.description: Observed rainfall measurements. Missing rainfall values are not treated as zero.

forecast.description: Weather forecast records supplied by the calling application. Forecast timestamps must fall strictly after prediction time and within the six-hour horizon.

processing_rules.missing_observation_policy: Missing rainfall observations are not converted to zero. Invalid, negative, future-dated and extreme observations are excluded from scoring.
processing_rules.extreme_reading_policy: Readings above 100 mm are flagged, excluded from scoring and counted in suspicious_readings_ignored.
processing_rules.negative_forecast_policy: Forecast records containing negative precipitation are rejected.
processing_rules.missing_forecast_precipitation_policy: A forecast assessment requires at least one valid precipitation measurement within the six-hour horizon. Missing precipitation is not converted to zero. If all in-horizon precipitation measurements are missing, the assessment is unavailable.
processing_rules.missing_probability_policy: Precipitation probability is optional. If no valid probability is supplied, its scoring contribution is omitted.
processing_rules.stale_observation_policy: If the latest accepted rainfall observation is older than three hours, the assessment is unavailable.

scoring_method.score_clipping: Scores are clipped to the range 0-100 and rounded to two decimal places.

risk_categories.unavailable: Required inputs are inadequate, invalid or stale.

scoring_method.important_limitation: When precipitation probability is unavailable, its contribution is omitted. Therefore, the maximum attainable score can be 80.

output.environmental_risk_score: number from 0 to 100, or null when unavailable
output.risk_category: low, moderate, high, very_high, or unavailable
output.interpretation: Experimental uncalibrated environmental score; not a flood probability or validated flood forecast.

safety_and_validity_rules: Do not label the score as a probability of flooding.
Do not claim supervised flood prediction without suitable independent flood labels.
Do not treat missing or stale observations as zero rainfall.
Flag every observed rainfall reading above 100 mm for investigation.
Do not silently delete, cap or alter suspicious source readings.
Do not infer ward-level inundation directly from a nearby rain gauge.
Mark the prediction unavailable when required inputs are inadequate.
Keep environmental risk separate from Sentinel-1 observed inundation evidence.

evaluation_plan.flood_validation: Pending discovery of reliable, independent, time-stamped Chennai flood outcomes. Do not report flood prediction accuracy before suitable evaluation data is available.

integration.fusion_rule: Keep environmental risk and satellite inundation evidence as separate signals. Do not blindly average their scores or produce an unsupported combined probability.
